lessons.lesson: A guard root must not contain the harness's own output, and an empty guard root is refused rather than certified — both measured live as ERR_GUARD_ROOT_CONTAINS_HARNESS_OUTPUT and ERR_GUARD_ROOT_EMPTY.
The contract source scan needs exactly one entry per required family; a second entry in a family is duplicate=True and an extra key is PL-SCHEMA.
TaskSpec ids derive from the project id's last segment, so two rounds sharing a last segment collide; choose a unique tail before the first admission attempt.
